decision_rationale: GeneLLM is presented as a new model, not a review or wrapper, and it directly interprets cfRNA sequences. The abstract and methods describe an LLM pretrained on cfRNA reads with a language-model-style bridge from biology to text-model processing.
evidence_snippet: “a novel large language model” that “directly interpreting plasma cell-free RNA (cfRNA) sequences”; “pretrained a cfRNA-based large language model using unlabelled cfRNA reads” to “generate cancer detection predictions”
